## Einride to Deploy 500 Tesla Semi Trucks in 2026 in Concrete Commercial Adoption Milestone

A 500-unit commercial Semi deployment is a meaningful proof-of-scale data point for TSLA's long-haul EV ambitions; if Einride's rollout proceeds on schedule, it creates a referenceable commercial use case that could accelerate conversations with other fleet operators.

- Logistics company Einride announced it will deploy 500 Tesla Semi trucks in 2026, per two outlets.
- The deployment is framed as a concrete commercial adoption milestone for TSLA's heavy-truck business.
- No deployment geography, timeline within 2026, contract terms, or pricing is disclosed in the headlines.
